spans.s:
m. (-टः)
A kind of fish, (Pimelodus gagora or P. tengara, HAM.)
E.
घर् an imitative sound, and घट to endeavour, affix अच्; who makes such a sound.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
One of the tones or notes in music.
m. (-रः)
1 The pass of a mountain.
2 A door, a gate.
3 An owl.
4 The name of a river, the Gogra or

Ghogra.
5

Sound.
6

Laughter, mirth.
7 A fire of straw or chaff.
f. (-रा or -री)
A girdle of small bells or tinkling ornaments worn by women.
f. (-रा)
A kind of lute.
E.
घर्घ here said to imply an inarticulate sound, gurgling, &c. and रा to give or take, affix डः also with कन् added घर्घरक.

m. (-वः)
A tinkling sound, the sound of small bells.
E.
घर्घरा, and रव sound.

f. (-का)
1 An ornament of small bells worn by women, horses, &c.
2 The bow or stick of a viol, &c.
3 A sort of musical instrument.
4 Fried grain.
5 The name of a river.
E.
घर्घरी as above, and कन् added fem. form.

m. (-घा)
1 A sort of insect.

r. 1st cl. (घर्बति)
To go, to move.

Heat.
2

The hot season.
3

Sunshine.
4

Sweat, perspiration.
E.
घृ to sprinkle, and मक् Uṇādi affix; what sprinkles the limbs.

f. (-का)
Eruptions from suppressed perspiration.
E.
घम्म, and चर्च्चिका.

m. (-तिः)
The sun.
E.
घर्म्म, and द्युति splendor.

n. (-यः)
1 Sweat, perspiration.
2 Warm water.
E.
घर्म्म, and पयस् water.

m. (-श्मिः)
1 The sun.
2 Heat, radiance.
E.
घर्म्म, and रश्मि a ray.

f. (-का)
Cutaneous eruptions or pimples from suppressed perspiration.
E.
घर्म्म, and विचर्च्चिका pustular eruption.

m. (-न्तः)
The rainy season.
E.
घर्म्म, and अन्त end.

m. (-की)
A small white bird; a kind of crane.
E.
घर्म्मान्त, and कामुकी who wishes for.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Suffering from heat.
E.
घर्म्म, and आर्त्त pained by.

n. (-म्बु)
1 Perspiration, sweat.
2 Warm water.
E.
घर्म्म, and अम्वु water.

Perspiration.
2

Warm water.
E.
घर्म्म, and उदक water.

m. (-र्षः)
Rubbing, friction.
E.
घृष to rub, घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Grinding, pounding.
2 Rubbing, friction.
f. (-णी)
Turmeric.
E.
घृष to grind, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-लः)
A wooden roller or pestle for grinding, &c.
E.
घर्षण rubbing, and अल what is fit for.

Rubbed.
2

Ground.
E.
घृष to rub, affix क्त.

m. (-रः)
Sprinkling, wetting.
E.
घृ to sprinkle, and घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
Pulse ground and fried with clarified butter.
E.
घृत ghee, and ठक् aff.
